title: Raspberries

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Raspberries are often found along the edges of large open meadows.
Raspberries are valuable in both early game as a basic food item and in mid-late game as a necessary ingredient for the early-tier Queen's jam and the Medium healing mead. Thus, gathering Raspberries when encountered is usually a good idea.

sections.heading: Availability
sections.text: • Bushes in the Meadows can be harvested for 1 Raspberries, affected by Farming (Skill). Bushes replenish after 5h. There is currently no way to replant berry bushes, and if they are destroyed they will not grow back.
